title: Episode 31
logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous):
blocks.text:

"The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Taunting):
blocks.text:

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Defiant, Steady):

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:25.00) | End: (00:28.90)
"Because this is what you were always meant to be."

Start: (00:29.00) | End: (00:34.80)

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Scornful):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:29.30) | End: (00:34.80)
"Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."

Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:34.80) | End: (00:39.00)
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:38.90)
"[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."

Start: (00:39.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:39.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:43.00)
"I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."

Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:48.50)
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:43.20) | End: (00:48.50)
"No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."

Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.80)
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:48.50) | End: (00:54.80)
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Gloating):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:48.90) | End: (00:50.80)
"Do you remember?"

Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.00)
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
blocks.action:

Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:54.80)
"Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."

Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:59.00)
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (00:59.00)
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.

blocks.text:

blocks.action:
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:57.50)
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:55.50) | End: (00:58.80)
"And everyone watched you walk away alone."

Start: (00:59.00) | End: (01:05.50)

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Proud, Measured):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:59.20) | End: (01:01.30)
"Gerald chose money."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:01.50) | End: (01:03.50)
"Clarissa chose a coward."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Unyielding):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:03.80) | End: (01:05.30)
"I chose myself."

Start: (01:05.50) | End: (01:07.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:05.50) | End: (01:07.50)
Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Disgusted):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:05.60) | End: (01:07.40)
"You chose a beggar."

Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:10.50)
Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Fierce, Proud):

"I chose a man."

Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Contemptuous):

Start: (01:13.30) | End: (01:17.60)

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:17.60)
"A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."

Start: (01:17.60) | End: (01:20.50)
Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:17.60) | End: (01:20.50)
Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:17.80) | End: (01:20.20)
"You call that marriage?"

Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:23.20)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:20.50) | End: (01:23.20)
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Pure, Sincere):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:20.80) | End: (01:23.20)
"I call it love."

blocks.camera:
Start: (01:23.20) | End: (01:28.00)
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:23.50) | End: (01:27.40)
"[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."

Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.20)

blocks.camera:
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.20)
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Firm, Piercing):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:27.80) | End: (01:31.20)
"To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."

Start: (01:31.20) | End: (01:34.20)
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:31.20) | End: (01:34.20)
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:31.40) | End: (01:34.20)
"You think love makes you better than me?"

Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:38.20)
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:34.20) | End: (01:38.20)
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:38.20)
"No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."

Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:43.50)
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:38.20) | End: (01:43.50)
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:38.50) | End: (01:43.30)
"I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"

Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:48.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:43.70) | End: (01:48.50)
"Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."

Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:50.50)
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:48.80) | End: (01:50.50)
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:50.20) | End: (01:51.40)
"[scoffs] Peasants? People?"

Start: (01:51.50) | End: (01:58.20)
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:51.50) | End: (01:58.20)
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:51.60) | End: (01:58.20)
"That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."

Start: (01:58.20) | End: (02:02.50)
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:58.20) | End: (02:02.50)
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:58.40) | End: (02:02.00)
"Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"

Start: (02:02.00) | End: (02:04.00)
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
blocks.action:

Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:04.00) | End: (02:10.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (02:04.00) | End: (02:10.80)
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:04.20) | End: (02:10.50)
"If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."

Start: (02:10.80) | End: (02:13.00)
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:10.80) | End: (02:13.00)
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

Start: (02:13.00) | End: (02:14.50)

blocks.text:
Start: (02:13.20) | End: (02:14.50)

blocks.action:
Start: (02:13.20) | End: (02:14.50)

blocks.text:
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:18.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:18.00)
Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:14.50) | End: (02:18.00)
"This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."

Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
blocks.action:
Start: (02:18.00) | End: (02:20.50)
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:18.40) | End: (02:20.40)
"[gasping] Give it back!"

Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:23.80)
Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:23.80)
Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:20.70) | End: (02:23.80)
"There. Finally. Something still hurts you."

Start: (02:23.80) | End: (02:25.50)
Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:23.80) | End: (02:25.50)
Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:25.50) | End: (02:31.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:25.50) | End: (02:31.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Vicious, Final):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:25.60) | End: (02:31.20)
"One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

Start: (02:31.20) | End: (02:35.20)
Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
blocks.camera:

Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.

Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
